text:
alex (eng-infra): Heads up — we need ENI/EIP/VPC IP quota increases in eu-west-1 for the upcoming GPU Dedicated rollout. Hitting limits when we try to scale test pool.

maria (networks): How many ENIs and EIPs are we short by? Also are we doing IPv6 or just IPv4 addresses?

alex (eng-infra): Current failures show ENI allocation errors when launching gpu-node groups. AWS account default ENI per AZ is 250 and we need ~1200 across 3 AZs for initial capacity. Requesting increase to 1500 ENIs per AZ. For EIPs, we need a pool of 600 (200 per AZ) for public-facing NAT/GW instances + worker IPs. IPv6: we want /56 VPCs enabled so pods can get IPv6 addresses, but that is secondary — main blocker is ENI + EIP.

jie (cloud-provisioning): Can you paste the exact error logs and the cloudformation/terraform module that hits the ENI limit? That helps support case.

alex (eng-infra): Error snippet: ```
Error creating network interface: AddressLimitExceeded: The maximum number of network interfaces has been reached for this account.
    status code: 400, request id: abc-123
```
Terraform module: `modules/gpu/autoscaling/aws_autoscaling_group` with `associate_public_ip_address = true` and `ena_support = true`. We also create a set of EIP resources per node for legacy routing.

sam (sre): Quick ask — can we avoid EIP per node? That will reduce EIP count a lot. Maybe use NAT gateways or EIP pools only for training ingress.

alex (eng-infra): We did that initially but dedicated fleet needs some nodes reachable for SSH/debug and billing probes that require static IPs. Also some customers require fixed outbound IP for allowlisting. We can reduce to 300 if needed but still need 300+ EIPs. I'll adjust numbers in the request.

maria (networks): For IPv6, enabling a VPC CIDR /56 per account is a soft limit. We'll ask support to enable IPv6 per VPC and allow auto-assignment on subnets. That also means updates to our routing tables and security groups. I'll prepare the network checklist.

alex (eng-infra): Submitted AWS support case via console, case ID: 0-9876-54321. Summary: Increase VPC IPv4 addresses, ENI quota to 1500 per AZ, EIP quota to 600. Please add any details or owner.

cloud-support-bot: Support case 0-9876-54321 updated: "We are reviewing your request for ENI and EIP quota increases in eu-west-1. Expected action within 48-72 hours."

jie (cloud-provisioning): I'll attach the terraform plan and expected scaling timeline to the case. Also adding tagging policy: all new ENIs/EIPs should have tags {"team":"eng-infra","project":"dedicated-gpu"}. Support sometimes needs that for quota tracking.

sam (sre): Also file a follow-up with the account owner to request a soft limit raise for NAT Gateways and Elastic IP address pool size — they sometimes require justification for increase >500. Include monthly expected EIP usage and IP churn.

maria (networks): Side note: check ENA vs ENI density per instance type — some GPU instances allow more ENIs per instance so we can optimize by using fewer nodes with higher interfaces. I'll run a capacity plan and post numbers by EOD.

alex (eng-infra): Action items: 1) jie attach tf plan + scaling schedule to case 0-9876-54321 (owner: jie) 2) maria run ENI density optimization and update request numbers (owner: maria) 3) sam prepare fallback plan to use NAT + fewer EIPs if support denies full increase (owner: sam). I'll update infra runbook once case closes. :thumbsup:

maria (networks): Added preliminary notes in #eng-infra/ops-docs. Will ping when optimization numbers are ready.

cloud-support-bot: Support case 0-9876-54321 status changed to "Information required". Message: "Please provide projected monthly EIP usage and justification for ENI increase beyond 1000 per AZ."

alex (eng-infra): I'll post the projection this afternoon.

sam (sre): FYI — tagging for cost center and customer-id is required by finance for >200 static IPs. Add `billing:dedicated-pool` tag.

jie (cloud-provisioning): Done. I updated the support case with the tf plan, expected node counts per week for next 3 months, and tagging policy. Case note: request ENI 1500/az, EIP 400 (revised), enable IPv6 per VPC /56.

cloud-support-bot: Case 0-9876-54321 updated. Engineer assigned: emily-aws. ETA for review: 36 hours.

alex (eng-infra): Great — will monitor. If it gets stalled, we may open a ticket with our TAM. Thanks all."
